---- MODULE W4Od7m2p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Cranes, MaxLog, MaxPrep

Prep == [base: 0..MaxLog, crane: Cranes]

VARIABLES version, writeLog, prepared, slow
vars == <<version, writeLog, prepared, slow>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ version \in 0..MaxLog
  /\ writeLog \in Seq([base: 0..MaxLog])
  /\ prepared \subseteq Prep
  /\ slow \subseteq Cranes

Init ==
  /\ version = 0
  /\ writeLog = << >>
  /\ prepared = {}
  /\ slow = {}

\* Phase one: a crane reads the current record version and prepares a write.
Prepare(cr) ==
  /\ Cardinality(prepared) < MaxPrep
  /\ version < MaxLog
  /\ prepared' = prepared \union {[base |-> version, crane |-> cr]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, writeLog, slow>>

\* Phase two: a prepared write commits only if the record version is still
\* the one it read, so it cannot silently overwrite an intervening update.
CommitWrite(w) ==
  /\ w \in prepared
  /\ w.base = version
  /\ writeLog' = Append(writeLog, [base |-> w.base])
  /\ version' = version + 1
  /\ prepared' = prepared \ {w}
  /\ UNCHANGED slow

\* A prepared write whose base version is now stale is aborted (and retried),
\* rather than being applied on top of an update it never saw.
AbortStale(w) ==
  /\ w \in prepared
  /\ w.base # version
  /\ prepared' = prepared \ {w}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, writeLog, slow>>

\* A crane becomes slow (lagging) but never fails.
MarkSlow(cr) ==
  /\ cr \notin slow
  /\ slow' = slow \union {cr}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, writeLog, prepared>>

\* A slow crane resumes normal speed.
Resume(cr) ==
  /\ cr \in slow
  /\ slow' = slow \ {cr}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, writeLog, prepared>>

Next ==
  \/ \E cr \in Cranes : Prepare(cr)
  \/ \E w \in Prep : CommitWrite(w)
  \/ \E w \in Prep : AbortStale(w)
  \/ \E cr \in Cranes : MarkSlow(cr)
  \/ \E cr \in Cranes : Resume(cr)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LenBound == Len(writeLog) <= MaxLog

NoLostUpdate ==
  \A i \in DOMAIN writeLog : writeLog[i].base = i - 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Cranes = {cr1, cr2}
  MaxLog = 3
  MaxPrep = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
CONSTRAINT LenBound
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A container-ship crane yard updates one shared stowage record through a two-phase commit so that no crane's update is ever silently lost. Each committed write records the record version it was built on. Cranes may be slow but never fail: a lagging crane eventually commits or aborts its prepared write. In phase one, a crane reads the current record version and prepares a write stamped with that version. In phase two, a prepared write commits only if the record version is still exactly the one the crane read, appending the write and advancing the version; this guarantees the write is layered on the very state it observed. A prepared write whose base version has since changed is aborted and would be retried, rather than being applied on top of an intervening update it never saw. A crane may become slow and later resume, but it never fails.

Actions: Prepare (phase one: a crane reads the current version and prepares a write), CommitWrite (phase two: commit only if the version still matches the one read, appending the write and advancing the version), AbortStale (abort a prepared write whose base version has since changed), MarkSlow (a crane starts lagging), Resume (a slow crane catches up).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the i-th committed write in the record log was always built on version i-1, so every update is layered on the state it observed and none is silently overwritten.

---- MODULE W4Od4m1p2t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Stations, Total, MaxCap

RECURSIVE FoldSum(_, _)
FoldSum(f, S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + FoldSum(f, S \ {x})

VARIABLES entry, pos, exit, token, cap
vars == <<entry, pos, exit, token, cap>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ entry \in 0..Total
  /\ pos \in [Stations -> 0..Total]
  /\ exit \in 0..Total
  /\ token \in Stations
  /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
  /\ entry = Total
  /\ pos = [s \in Stations |-> 0]
  /\ exit = 0
  /\ token = CHOOSE s \in Stations : TRUE
  /\ cap = 0

\* The conveyor's in-service slot capacity is reconfigured at runtime.
SetCap(k) ==
  /\ k \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ k # cap
  /\ cap' = k
  /\ UNCHANGED <<entry, pos, exit, token>>

\* The token-holding station pulls a waiting car in, if room remains.
Admit ==
  /\ entry > 0
  /\ FoldSum(pos, Stations) < cap
  /\ entry' = entry - 1
  /\ pos' = [pos EXCEPT ![token] = pos[token] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<exit, token, cap>>

\* The token-holding station pushes one of its cars out to the exit.
Advance ==
  /\ pos[token] > 0
  /\ pos' = [pos EXCEPT ![token] = pos[token] - 1]
  /\ exit' = exit + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<entry, token, cap>>

\* The exclusive move token advances to the next station in the ring.
PassToken(n) ==
  /\ token = n
  /\ token' \in {m \in Stations : m # n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<entry, pos, exit, cap>>

\* A finished car re-enters the queue for another pass.
Recirculate ==
  /\ exit > 0
  /\ exit' = exit - 1
  /\ entry' = entry + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pos, token, cap>>

Next ==
  \/ \E k \in 0..MaxCap : SetCap(k)
  \/ Admit
  \/ Advance
  \/ \E n \in Stations : PassToken(n)
  \/ Recirculate

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CarsConserved ==
  entry + FoldSum(pos, Stations) + exit = Total
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Stations = {st1, st2}
  Total = 2
  MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CarsConserved
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line moves a fixed set of cars through wash stations, where every car is always in the entry queue, at some station, or at the exit — none are created or destroyed. Exclusive rights to move a car are granted by a token that circulates around the ring of stations. The number of in-service conveyor slots changes at runtime as stations are opened and closed. The slot capacity is reconfigured to any value at runtime. The token-holding station pulls a waiting car in from the entry queue, but only while the total number of cars in stations is below the current capacity. The token-holding station pushes one of its cars out to the exit. The exclusive move token advances from its holder to the next station in the ring. A finished car at the exit may re-enter the entry queue for another pass.

Actions: SetCap (reconfigure the in-service slot capacity at runtime), Admit (the token holder pulls a waiting car into its station while under capacity), Advance (the token holder pushes one car out to the exit), PassToken (the exclusive move token advances to the next ring station), Recirculate (a finished car re-enters the entry queue).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of cars across the entry queue, all stations, and the exit is always exactly the fixed set the line started with.

None == "none"

FoldSum(f, S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + FoldSum(f, S \ {x})

VARIABLES leader, up, unassigned, assigned, completed

  /\ up \subseteq Instances
  /\ unassigned \in 0..Total
  /\ assigned \in [Drones -> 0..Total]

  /\ leader = None
  /\ up = Instances
  /\ unassigned = Total
  /\ assigned = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
  /\ completed = 0

\* A live instance with no standing leader is elected pool coordinator.
Elect(n) ==
  /\ n \in up
  /\ leader = None
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ UNCHANGED <<up, unassigned, assigned, completed>>

\* The coordinating instance fails; the shared pool is leaderless.
Fail(n) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ up' = up \ {n}
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<unassigned, assigned, completed>>

\* A downed instance recovers and rejoins.
Recover(n) ==
  /\ n \notin up
  /\ up' = up \union {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, unassigned, assigned, completed>>

\* The coordinator assigns one unassigned survey task to a drone.
Assign(d) ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ unassigned > 0
  /\ unassigned' = unassigned - 1
  /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![d] = assigned[d] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up, completed>>

\* A drone completes one of its assigned tasks.
Complete(d) ==
  /\ assigned[d] > 0
  /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![d] = assigned[d] - 1]
  /\ completed' = completed + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up, unassigned>>

\* A completed area is re-queued for another survey.
Reissue ==
  /\ completed > 0
  /\ completed' = completed - 1
  /\ unassigned' = unassigned + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up, assigned>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Instances : Elect(n)
  \/ \E n \in Instances : Fail(n)
  \/ \E n \in Instances : Recover(n)
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Assign(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Complete(d)
  \/ Reissue

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TasksConserved ==
  unassigned + FoldSum(assigned, Drones) + completed = Total
====

  Instances = {i1, i2}
  Drones = {dr1, dr2}
  Total = 2

nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm tracks a fixed set of survey tasks that are never created or destroyed: each task is always unassigned, assigned to a drone, or completed. Two independent controller instances share one task pool and coordinate through leader election with failover. A live instance with no standing leader is elected pool coordinator.   /\ UNCHANGED <<yard, air, ship, token>>

  /\ slow' = slow \ {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<yard, air, ship, token>>

  \/ LiftFromShip

---- MODULE W4Od4m5p4t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Controllers, Quorum, Cap, Total

VARIABLES waiting, occupied, washed, approvals
vars == <<waiting, occupied, washed, approvals>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ waiting \in 0..Total
  /\ occupied \in 0..(Cap + 1)
  /\ washed \in 0..Total
  /\ approvals \subseteq Controllers

Init ==
  /\ waiting = Total
  /\ occupied = 0
  /\ washed = 0
  /\ approvals = {}

\* A controller approves the next admission into the wash bays.
Approve(c) ==
  /\ c \notin approvals
  /\ approvals' = approvals \union {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, occupied, washed>>

\* With a quorum of approvals, a waiting car is admitted -- but only if a
\* bay is free, so capacity is respected.
AdmitByQuorum ==
  /\ Cardinality(approvals) >= Quorum
  /\ occupied < Cap
  /\ waiting > 0
  /\ waiting' = waiting - 1
  /\ occupied' = occupied + 1
  /\ approvals' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED washed

\* The privileged admin override admits a waiting car bypassing the quorum,
\* but it too respects the bay capacity.
AdmitByAdmin ==
  /\ occupied < Cap
  /\ waiting > 0
  /\ waiting' = waiting - 1
  /\ occupied' = occupied + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<washed, approvals>>

\* A car finishes its wash and leaves its bay.
Finish ==
  /\ occupied > 0
  /\ occupied' = occupied - 1
  /\ washed' = washed + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, approvals>>

\* A washed car rejoins the waiting line for another wash.
Recirculate ==
  /\ washed > 0
  /\ washed' = washed - 1
  /\ waiting' = waiting + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<occupied, approvals>>

\* The pending approvals are cleared without admitting.
ClearApprovals ==
  /\ approvals # {}
  /\ approvals' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, occupied, washed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Approve(c)
  \/ AdmitByQuorum
  \/ AdmitByAdmin
  \/ Finish
  \/ Recirculate
  \/ ClearApprovals

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BaysWithinCapacity == occupied <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Controllers = {cn1, cn2, cn3}
  Quorum = 2
  Cap = 2
  Total = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BaysWithinCapacity
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line admits cars into a bounded set of wash bays, and admission is normally decided by quorum voting among the controllers, though a privileged admin can override the vote. Either way, the bay capacity must never be exceeded. A controller approves the next admission. Once a quorum of approvals is reached and a bay is free, a waiting car is admitted and the approval tally is cleared. The privileged admin override may admit a waiting car without any quorum, but it still admits only while a bay is free, so it never breaches capacity. A car in a bay finishes its wash and leaves. A washed car rejoins the waiting line for another wash. The pending approvals may be cleared without admitting anyone.

Actions: Approve (a controller approves the next admission), AdmitByQuorum (admit a waiting car once a quorum approves and a bay is free, clearing the tally), AdmitByAdmin (the admin override admits a waiting car bypassing the quorum but still only when a bay is free), Finish (a car completes its wash and leaves its bay), Recirculate (a washed car rejoins the waiting line), ClearApprovals (discard the pending approvals).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of cars occupying wash bays never exceeds the fixed bay capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od5m4p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Instances, QMax, Cap, Total

None == "none"

VARIABLES queue, active, lock, done
vars == <<queue, active, lock, done>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ queue \in 0..(QMax + 1)
  /\ active \in 0..(Cap + 1)
  /\ lock \in Instances \union {None}
  /\ done \in 0..Total

Init ==
  /\ queue = 0
  /\ active = 0
  /\ lock = None
  /\ done = 0

\* An instance takes the shared pool's coordination lock.
Acquire(i) ==
  /\ lock = None
  /\ lock' = i
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, active, done>>

\* The lock-holding instance releases the shared pool.
Release(i) ==
  /\ lock = i
  /\ lock' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, active, done>>

\* The lock holder enqueues a match request under backpressure.
Enqueue(i) ==
  /\ lock = i
  /\ queue < QMax
  /\ queue' = queue + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<active, lock, done>>

\* The lock holder dispatches a queued request into an active match.
Dispatch(i) ==
  /\ lock = i
  /\ queue > 0
  /\ active < Cap
  /\ queue' = queue - 1
  /\ active' = active + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, done>>

\* An active match completes.
Complete ==
  /\ active > 0
  /\ done < Total
  /\ active' = active - 1
  /\ done' = done + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, lock>>

\* A completed match is re-queued for a rematch, still under backpressure.
Requeue ==
  /\ done > 0
  /\ queue < QMax
  /\ done' = done - 1
  /\ queue' = queue + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<active, lock>>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Instances : Acquire(i)
  \/ \E i \in Instances : Release(i)
  \/ \E i \in Instances : Enqueue(i)
  \/ \E i \in Instances : Dispatch(i)
  \/ Complete
  \/ Requeue

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

QueueWithinBackpressure == queue <= QMax
====

CONSTANTS
  Instances = {i1, i2}
  QMax = 2
  Cap = 2
  Total = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT QueueWithinBackpressure
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker feeds match requests through a bounded work queue with backpressure, shared by two independent matchmaker instances. The queue must never grow past its backpressure limit. The two instances coordinate through a single shared-pool lock so only one mutates the queue at a time. An instance takes the shared pool's coordination lock when it is free, and releases it when done. The lock-holding instance enqueues a new match request, but only while the queue is below its backpressure limit. The lock holder dispatches a queued request into an active match while match capacity remains. An active match completes and is counted done. A completed match may be re-queued for a rematch, again only while the queue is below its backpressure limit.

Actions: Acquire (an instance takes the shared-pool lock), Release (the lock holder frees the shared pool), Enqueue (the lock holder adds a request while under the backpressure limit), Dispatch (the lock holder turns a queued request into an active match while capacity remains), Complete (an active match finishes), Requeue (a completed match re-enters the queue under backpressure).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of queued match requests never exceeds the queue's backpressure limit.

---- MODULE W4Od15m3p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Nodes, Updates

None == "none"

VARIABLES record, acked, leader, up, inflight
vars == <<record, acked, leader, up, inflight>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ record \subseteq Updates
  /\ acked \subseteq Updates
  /\ leader \in Nodes \union {None}
  /\ up \subseteq Nodes
  /\ inflight \subseteq Updates

Init ==
  /\ record = {}
  /\ acked = {}
  /\ leader = None
  /\ up = Nodes
  /\ inflight = {}

\* A live node with no standing leader is elected to own the shared record.
Elect(n) ==
  /\ n \in up
  /\ leader = None
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, up, inflight>>

\* The record owner fails; the record is ownerless until failover.
Fail(n) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ up' = up \ {n}
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, inflight>>

\* A downed node recovers and rejoins.
Recover(n) ==
  /\ n \notin up
  /\ up' = up \union {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, leader, inflight>>

\* A client submits an update to the current leader; messages may reorder.
Submit(u) ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ u \notin inflight
  /\ inflight' = inflight \union {u}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, leader, up>>

\* The leader merges an in-flight update into the record and acknowledges it.
\* Updates are merged (never overwriting), and may be applied in any order.
Apply(u) ==
  /\ u \in inflight
  /\ record' = record \union {u}
  /\ acked' = acked \union {u}
  /\ inflight' = inflight \ {u}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up>>

\* An update that was never acknowledged may be evicted from the record.
Evict(u) ==
  /\ u \in record
  /\ u \notin acked
  /\ record' = record \ {u}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<acked, leader, up, inflight>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Fail(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)
  \/ \E u \in Updates : Submit(u)
  \/ \E u \in Updates : Apply(u)
  \/ \E u \in Updates : Evict(u)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
  acked \subseteq record
====
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction maintains one shared record of order-book updates under an elected leader with failover, and no acknowledged update may ever be lost from the record. Because the network reorders messages, submitted updates may be merged into the record in any order. A live node with no standing leader is elected to own the shared record. The record owner may fail, leaving the record ownerless until a new leader is elected; a downed node may later recover and rejoin. A client submits an update to the current leader, placing it in flight. The leader merges an in-flight update into the record and acknowledges it back to the client; updates are always merged, never overwriting the record, and may be applied in any order. An update that was never acknowledged may be evicted from the record, but an acknowledged one may not.

Actions: Elect (a live node with no leader becomes record owner), Fail (the owner fails and the record becomes ownerless), Recover (a downed node rejoins), Submit (a client puts an update in flight to the leader), Apply (the leader merges an in-flight update into the record and acknowledges it, in any order), Evict (remove a never-acknowledged update from the record).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every update that has been acknowledged to a client is still present in the shared record, so no acknowledged update is ever lost.

---- MODULE W4Od19m8p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Shelves, Members, Total

None == "none"
Req == [shelf: Shelves, member: Members]

RECURSIVE FoldSum(_, _)
FoldSum(f, S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + FoldSum(f, S \ {x})

VARIABLES onShelf, reserved, out, coarse, reqPool
vars == <<onShelf, reserved, out, coarse, reqPool>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ onShelf \in [Shelves -> 0..Total]
  /\ reserved \in 0..Total
  /\ out \in 0..Total
  /\ coarse \in [Shelves -> Members \union {None}]
  /\ reqPool \subseteq Req

Init ==
  /\ onShelf = [s \in Shelves |-> IF s = (CHOOSE x \in Shelves : TRUE) THEN Total ELSE 0]
  /\ reserved = 0
  /\ out = 0
  /\ coarse = [s \in Shelves |-> None]
  /\ reqPool = {}

\* Take a shelf's coarse lock (the top of the lock hierarchy).
AcquireCoarse(sh, m) ==
  /\ coarse[sh] = None
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![sh] = m]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<onShelf, reserved, out, reqPool>>

\* Release a shelf's coarse lock.
ReleaseCoarse(sh, m) ==
  /\ coarse[sh] = m
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![sh] = None]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<onShelf, reserved, out, reqPool>>

\* A member submits a reservation request; requests may be served in any order.
Request(sh, m) ==
  /\ [shelf |-> sh, member |-> m] \notin reqPool
  /\ reqPool' = reqPool \union {[shelf |-> sh, member |-> m]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<onShelf, reserved, out, coarse>>

\* Reserve a copy: only while holding the shelf's coarse lock and a copy is on
\* the shelf, moving one copy from the shelf into the reserved pool.
Reserve(rq) ==
  /\ rq \in reqPool
  /\ coarse[rq.shelf] = rq.member
  /\ onShelf[rq.shelf] > 0
  /\ onShelf' = [onShelf EXCEPT ![rq.shelf] = onShelf[rq.shelf] - 1]
  /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
  /\ reqPool' = reqPool \ {rq}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<out, coarse>>

\* A reserved copy is checked out.
Checkout ==
  /\ reserved > 0
  /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
  /\ out' = out + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<onShelf, coarse, reqPool>>

\* A checked-out copy is returned to a shelf.
Return(sh) ==
  /\ out > 0
  /\ out' = out - 1
  /\ onShelf' = [onShelf EXCEPT ![sh] = onShelf[sh] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, coarse, reqPool>>

Next ==
  \/ \E sh \in Shelves, m \in Members : AcquireCoarse(sh, m)
  \/ \E sh \in Shelves, m \in Members : ReleaseCoarse(sh, m)
  \/ \E sh \in Shelves, m \in Members : Request(sh, m)
  \/ \E rq \in Req : Reserve(rq)
  \/ Checkout
  \/ \E sh \in Shelves : Return(sh)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CopiesConserved ==

  Members = {m1, m2}
  Total = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CopiesConserved
nl:
A library book reservation system tracks a fixed number of copies that are never created or destroyed: each copy is always on a shelf, in the reserved pool, or checked out. Reservations are protected by a lock hierarchy — a coarse shelf lock taken first — and because requests can be reordered, they may be served in any order. A member takes a shelf's coarse lock when it is free, and releases it when done. A member submits a reservation request into the request pool. Reserving a copy requires holding that shelf's coarse lock and a copy being on the shelf; it moves one copy from the shelf into the reserved pool and clears the request. A reserved copy is checked out, moving it from reserved to checked-out. A checked-out copy is later returned to a shelf.

Actions: AcquireCoarse (take a shelf's coarse lock), ReleaseCoarse (release a shelf's coarse lock), Request (submit a reservation request to the pool), Reserve (move a copy from shelf to reserved while holding the coarse lock, serving any pooled request), Checkout (move a reserved copy to checked-out), Return (return a checked-out copy to a shelf).

---- MODULE W4Od2m2p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Robots, MaxCap

None == "none"

VARIABLES contending, cap, crit, candidate, votes
vars == <<contending, cap, crit, candidate, votes>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ contending \subseteq Robots
  /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ crit \subseteq Robots
  /\ candidate \in Robots \union {None}
  /\ votes \in [Robots -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]

Init ==
  /\ contending = {}
  /\ cap = 0
  /\ crit = {}
  /\ candidate = None
  /\ votes = [r \in Robots |-> "none"]

\* The contention-arena capacity is reconfigured at runtime.
SetCap(k) ==
  /\ k \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ k # cap
  /\ cap' = k
  /\ UNCHANGED <<contending, crit, candidate, votes>>

\* A robot joins the contention arena while there is room under capacity.
EnterArena(r) ==
  /\ r \notin contending
  /\ Cardinality(contending) < cap
  /\ contending' = contending \union {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, crit, candidate, votes>>

\* A contending robot starts a 2PC round to claim the critical section.
StartVote(r) ==
  /\ candidate = None
  /\ r \in contending
  /\ candidate' = r
  /\ votes' = [x \in Robots |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<contending, cap, crit>>

\* A contending robot votes on the current candidate.
Vote(r, v) ==
  /\ candidate # None
  /\ r \in contending
  /\ v \in {"yes", "no"}
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![r] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<contending, cap, crit, candidate>>

\* The candidate enters the critical section only after unanimous approval
\* and only while the section is empty (the mutual-exclusion guard).
EnterCrit ==
  /\ candidate # None
  /\ \A r \in contending : votes[r] = "yes"
  /\ crit = {}
  /\ crit' = crit \union {candidate}
  /\ candidate' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<contending, cap, votes>>

\* The current 2PC round is abandoned.
AbortVote ==
  /\ candidate # None
  /\ candidate' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<contending, cap, crit, votes>>

\* A robot leaves the critical section and the arena.
ExitCrit(r) ==
  /\ r \in crit
  /\ crit' = crit \ {r}
  /\ contending' = contending \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, candidate, votes>>

Next ==
  \/ \E k \in 0..MaxCap : SetCap(k)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : EnterArena(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : StartVote(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(r, v)
  \/ EnterCrit
  \/ AbortVote
  \/ \E r \in Robots : ExitCrit(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualExclusion ==
  \A r1, r2 \in crit : r1 = r2
====

  Robots = {rr1, rr2}
  MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next

nl:
A warehouse robot fleet guards a single shared critical section (a narrow aisle) so that only one robot is ever inside, and robots agree on entry through two-phase commit. The size of the contention arena — how many robots may compete for entry at once — changes at runtime. The arena capacity is reconfigured to any value at runtime. A robot joins the contention arena while there is room under the current capacity. A contending robot starts a two-phase-commit round to claim the aisle, becoming the candidate and clearing the votes. Each contending robot votes yes or no on the current candidate. The candidate enters the aisle only after every contender has voted yes and only while the aisle is empty. A round may instead be abandoned. A robot in the aisle eventually leaves, freeing it and leaving the arena.

Actions: SetCap (reconfigure the contention-arena capacity at runtime), EnterArena (a robot joins contention while under capacity), StartVote (a contender opens a 2PC round as the candidate), Vote (a contender votes yes or no on the candidate), EnterCrit (the candidate enters the aisle after unanimous approval and only when it is empty), AbortVote (abandon the current round), ExitCrit (a robot leaves the aisle and the arena).

SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one robot is ever inside the critical aisle at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od12m0p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Writes, Instances, MaxVer, MaxPend

Pend == [write: Writes, seen: 0..MaxVer, inst: Instances]

VARIABLES applied, acked, ver, pending
vars == <<applied, acked, ver, pending>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ applied \subseteq Writes
  /\ acked \subseteq Writes
  /\ ver \in 0..MaxVer
  /\ pending \subseteq Pend

Init ==
  /\ applied = {}
  /\ acked = {}
  /\ ver = 0
  /\ pending = {}

\* An instance optimistically starts a write, recording the version it read.
Begin(w, i) ==
  /\ Cardinality(pending) < MaxPend
  /\ pending' = pending \union {[write |-> w, seen |-> ver, inst |-> i]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<applied, acked, ver>>

\* The write commits only if the version it read is still current, which
\* rules out silently clobbering an intervening write; it is then acked.
Commit(p) ==
  /\ p \in pending
  /\ p.seen = ver
  /\ ver < MaxVer
  /\ applied' = applied \union {p.write}
  /\ acked' = acked \union {p.write}
  /\ ver' = ver + 1
  /\ pending' = pending \ {p}

\* A write whose read version is now stale is dropped and would be retried.
Retry(p) ==
  /\ p \in pending
  /\ p.seen # ver
  /\ pending' = pending \ {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<applied, acked, ver>>

\* An instance voluntarily abandons a pending write.
Abandon(p) ==
  /\ p \in pending
  /\ pending' = pending \ {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<applied, acked, ver>>

\* A write that was applied but never acknowledged may be rolled back.
Evict(w) ==
  /\ w \in applied
  /\ w \notin acked
  /\ applied' = applied \ {w}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<acked, ver, pending>>

Next ==
  \/ \E w \in Writes, i \in Instances : Begin(w, i)
  \/ \E p \in Pend : Commit(p)
  \/ \E p \in Pend : Retry(p)
  \/ \E p \in Pend : Abandon(p)
  \/ \E w \in Writes : Evict(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
  acked \subseteq applied
====

  Instances = {i1, i2}
  MaxVer = 2
  MaxPend = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker keeps a shared donation record consistent under optimistic locking with retry, with two independent instances sharing the record. No write that has been acknowledged as durable may ever be lost. An instance optimistically starts a write, recording the record version it read. The write commits only if the version it read is still the current one, which rules out silently clobbering an update made in the meantime; committing applies the write, marks it acknowledged, and advances the version. A write whose read version has since gone stale is dropped and would be retried. An instance may also voluntarily abandon a pending write. A write that was applied but never acknowledged may be rolled back out of the record, but an acknowledged write may not.

Actions: Begin (an instance optimistically starts a write, recording the observed version), Commit (apply and acknowledge the write only if its read version is still current, advancing the version), Retry (drop a write whose read version is now stale), Abandon (voluntarily drop a pending write), Evict (roll back an applied-but-unacknowledged write).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every write that has been acknowledged as durable is still present in the record, so no acknowledged update is ever lost.

---- MODULE W4Od3m6p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Banks, MaxT, MaxDur

None == "none"

VARIABLES clock, holder, expiry, acting, pending
vars == <<clock, holder, expiry, acting, pending>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ clock \in 0..MaxT
  /\ holder \in Banks \union {None}
  /\ expiry \in 0..MaxT
  /\ acting \in Banks \union {None}
  /\ pending \subseteq Banks

Init ==
  /\ clock = 0
  /\ holder = None
  /\ expiry = 0
  /\ acting = None
  /\ pending = {}

\* A bank is granted the settlement lease with an expiry time.
Grant(b, dur) ==
  /\ holder = None
  /\ dur \in 1..MaxDur
  /\ holder' = b
  /\ expiry' = IF clock + dur > MaxT THEN MaxT ELSE clock + dur
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, acting, pending>>

\* The lease holder renews its lease before it lapses.
Renew(b, dur) ==
  /\ holder = b
  /\ clock <= expiry
  /\ dur \in 1..MaxDur
  /\ expiry' = IF clock + dur > MaxT THEN MaxT ELSE clock + dur
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, acting, pending>>

\* Time advances; if the lease has now lapsed, ownership and any action clear.
Tick ==
  /\ clock < MaxT
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ IF clock + 1 > expiry
       THEN /\ holder' = None
            /\ acting' = None
       ELSE UNCHANGED <<holder, acting>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<expiry, pending>>

\* A settlement request arrives (requests may be reordered).
Request(b) ==
  /\ b \notin pending
  /\ pending' = pending \union {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry, acting>>

\* Only the current, unexpired lease holder posts a settlement (any order).
Act(b) ==
  /\ b \in pending
  /\ holder = b
  /\ clock <= expiry
  /\ acting = None
  /\ acting' = b
  /\ pending' = pending \ {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry>>

\* The acting bank finishes its settlement.
Finish(b) ==
  /\ acting = b
  /\ acting' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry, pending>>

\* The lease holder voluntarily releases the lease.
Release(b) ==
  /\ holder = b
  /\ holder' = None
  /\ acting' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, expiry, pending>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Banks, dur \in 1..MaxDur : Grant(b, dur)
  \/ \E b \in Banks, dur \in 1..MaxDur : Renew(b, dur)
  \/ Tick
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Request(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Act(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Finish(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Release(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleActor ==
  acting # None => (holder = acting /\ clock <= expiry)
====

CONSTANTS
  Banks = {bk1, bk2}
  MaxT = 2
  MaxDur = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleActor
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch grants exclusive ownership of the settlement ledger through a time-bounded lease, so that no bank ever posts a settlement under an expired lease. Requests can be reordered and may be acted on in any order. A bank is granted the lease with an expiry time. The holder may renew its lease before it lapses. Time advances by ticks; when a tick pushes the clock past the lease's expiry, ownership and any in-progress action are cleared, because the lease has lapsed. A settlement request arrives into the request pool. Only the current, unexpired lease holder may post a settlement, serving any pooled request. The acting bank finishes its settlement. The lease holder may also voluntarily release the lease.

Actions: Grant (give a bank the lease with an expiry), Renew (the holder extends its lease before it lapses), Tick (advance the clock, clearing ownership and action if the lease has lapsed), Request (a settlement request arrives, in any order), Act (only the current unexpired lease holder posts a settlement), Finish (the acting bank completes), Release (the holder gives up the lease).

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a bank is posting a settlement, it currently holds the lease and the lease has not expired, so no stale or unauthorized participant ever acts.

---- MODULE W4Od13m7p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Slots, Buyers, MaxDispense

VARIABLES reg, by, slow, dispensed
vars == <<reg, by, slow, dispensed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ reg \in [Slots -> {"free", "held"}]
  /\ by \in [Buyers -> SUBSET Slots]
  /\ slow \subseteq Buyers
  /\ dispensed \in [Buyers -> 0..MaxDispense]

Init ==
  /\ reg = [s \in Slots |-> "free"]
  /\ by = [b \in Buyers |-> {}]
  /\ slow = {}
  /\ dispensed = [b \in Buyers |-> 0]

\* Compare-and-swap a slot's register free -> held, claiming it for a buyer.
Claim(s, b) ==
  /\ reg[s] = "free"
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![s] = "held"]
  /\ by' = [by EXCEPT ![b] = by[b] \union {s}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<slow, dispensed>>

\* A buyer dispenses a held slot, freeing its register and counting the sale.
Dispense(s, b) ==
  /\ s \in by[b]
  /\ dispensed[b] < MaxDispense
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![s] = "free"]
  /\ by' = [by EXCEPT ![b] = by[b] \ {s}]
  /\ dispensed' = [dispensed EXCEPT ![b] = dispensed[b] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED slow

\* A buyer becomes slow (lagging) but never fails.
MarkSlow(b) ==
  /\ b \notin slow
  /\ slow' = slow \union {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, by, dispensed>>

\* A slow buyer resumes normal speed.
Resume(b) ==
  /\ b \in slow
  /\ slow' = slow \ {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, by, dispensed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Slots, b \in Buyers : Claim(s, b)
  \/ \E s \in Slots, b \in Buyers : Dispense(s, b)
  \/ \E b \in Buyers : MarkSlow(b)
  \/ \E b \in Buyers : Resume(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAllocation ==
  \A b1, b2 \in Buyers : b1 # b2 => (by[b1] \cap by[b2] = {})
====

A vending machine network assigns product slots to buyers using a compare-and-swap register on each slot, so that no slot is ever allocated to two buyers. Buyers may be slow but never fail. A buyer claims a slot by compare-and-swapping its register from free to held, adding the slot to the buyer's held set. A buyer dispenses one of its held slots, freeing that slot's register and counting the sale. A buyer may become slow (lagging) and later resume normal speed, but it never fails.

---- MODULE W4Od0m8p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Depts, ORs, Surgeons, Instances

None == "none"

VARIABLES coarse, booked, authorized, schedLock
vars == <<coarse, booked, authorized, schedLock>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ coarse \in [Depts -> Surgeons \union {None}]
  /\ booked \in [ORs -> Surgeons \union {None}]
  /\ authorized \subseteq Surgeons
  /\ schedLock \in Instances \union {None}

Init ==
  /\ coarse = [d \in Depts |-> None]
  /\ booked = [o \in ORs |-> None]
  /\ authorized = {}
  /\ schedLock = None

\* A surgeon is credentialed (authorized) to book operating rooms.
Authorize(s) ==
  /\ s \notin authorized
  /\ authorized' = authorized \union {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, booked, schedLock>>

\* Credentials are revoked; the surgeon loses its dept locks and bookings.
Deauthorize(s) ==
  /\ s \in authorized
  /\ authorized' = authorized \ {s}
  /\ coarse' = [d \in Depts |-> IF coarse[d] = s THEN None ELSE coarse[d]]
  /\ booked' = [o \in ORs |-> IF booked[o] = s THEN None ELSE booked[o]]
  /\ UNCHANGED schedLock

\* An instance takes the shared schedule lock.
TakeSched(i) ==
  /\ schedLock = None
  /\ schedLock' = i
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, booked, authorized>>

\* The lock-holding instance releases the shared schedule.
DropSched(i) ==
  /\ schedLock = i
  /\ schedLock' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, booked, authorized>>

\* An authorized surgeon takes a department's coarse lock (top of hierarchy).
AcquireCoarse(d, s) ==
  /\ coarse[d] = None
  /\ s \in authorized
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![d] = s]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<booked, authorized, schedLock>>

\* Book an OR: needs the shared schedule lock, a held dept lock, credentials.
Book(o, d, s, i) ==
  /\ schedLock = i
  /\ coarse[d] = s
  /\ s \in authorized
  /\ booked[o] = None
  /\ booked' = [booked EXCEPT ![o] = s]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, authorized, schedLock>>

\* A surgeon cancels its own booking.
Cancel(o, s) ==
  /\ booked[o] = s
  /\ booked' = [booked EXCEPT ![o] = None]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, authorized, schedLock>>

\* A surgeon releases a department's coarse lock.
ReleaseCoarse(d, s) ==
  /\ coarse[d] = s
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![d] = None]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<booked, authorized, schedLock>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Surgeons : Authorize(s)
  \/ \E s \in Surgeons : Deauthorize(s)
  \/ \E i \in Instances : TakeSched(i)
  \/ \E i \in Instances : DropSched(i)
  \/ \E d \in Depts, s \in Surgeons : AcquireCoarse(d, s)
  \/ \E o \in ORs, d \in Depts, s \in Surgeons, i \in Instances : Book(o, d, s, i)
  \/ \E o \in ORs, s \in Surgeons : Cancel(o, s)
  \/ \E d \in Depts, s \in Surgeons : ReleaseCoarse(d, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OnlyAuthorizedBookings ==

A hospital operating-room scheduler lets only credentialed surgeons book operating rooms, protecting the schedule with a lock hierarchy (a department coarse lock taken before booking a room). Two independent scheduler instances share one schedule and coordinate through a shared schedule lock. A surgeon is credentialed by becoming authorized. Credentials may be revoked, which also strips that surgeon of any department locks and any room bookings it holds. An instance takes the shared schedule lock, and releases it when done. An authorized surgeon takes a department's coarse lock when it is free. Booking a room requires the instance to hold the shared schedule lock, the surgeon to hold the department's coarse lock, the surgeon to be authorized, and the room to be free. A surgeon cancels its own booking. A surgeon releases a department's coarse lock.

Actions: Authorize (credential a surgeon), Deauthorize (revoke credentials and strip the surgeon's dept locks and bookings), TakeSched (an instance takes the shared schedule lock), DropSched (the instance releases the shared schedule lock), AcquireCoarse (an authorized surgeon takes a department's coarse lock), Book (book a free room while holding the schedule lock, the dept lock, and credentials), Cancel (a surgeon cancels its booking), ReleaseCoarse (release a department's coarse lock).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every booked operating room is held by a currently credentialed surgeon, so no unauthorized or stale participant ever holds a booking.

---- MODULE W4Od1m8p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Sectors, Runways, Ctrls, MaxV

None == "none"

VARIABLES record, applied, coarse, fine, pool
vars == <<record, applied, coarse, fine, pool>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ record \in 0..MaxV
  /\ applied \subseteq 1..MaxV
  /\ coarse \in [Sectors -> Ctrls \union {None}]
  /\ fine \in [Runways -> Ctrls \union {None}]
  /\ pool \subseteq 1..MaxV

Init ==
  /\ record = 0
  /\ applied = {}
  /\ coarse = [s \in Sectors |-> None]
  /\ fine = [r \in Runways |-> None]
  /\ pool = {}

\* Take a sector's coarse lock (the top of the lock hierarchy).
AcquireCoarse(sec, c) ==
  /\ coarse[sec] = None
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![sec] = c]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, applied, fine, pool>>

\* Take a runway's fine lock only while holding some sector's coarse lock.
AcquireFine(rw, sec, c) ==
  /\ coarse[sec] = c
  /\ fine[rw] = None
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![rw] = c]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, applied, coarse, pool>>

\* A controller submits a flight-plan update; updates may be reordered.
Submit(u) ==
  /\ u \notin pool
  /\ pool' = pool \union {u}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, applied, coarse, fine>>

\* Apply an update while holding coarse and fine locks. The record is raised
\* to reflect the update (monotone max), so an update is never lost even when
\* applied out of order.
Apply(u, sec, rw, c) ==
  /\ u \in pool
  /\ coarse[sec] = c
  /\ fine[rw] = c
  /\ u \notin applied
  /\ applied' = applied \union {u}
  /\ record' = IF u > record THEN u ELSE record
  /\ pool' = pool \ {u}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

\* A controller releases the coarse and fine locks it holds.
ReleaseLocks(sec, rw, c) ==
  /\ coarse[sec] = c
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![sec] = None]
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![rw] = IF fine[rw] = c THEN None ELSE fine[rw]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, applied, pool>>

Next ==
  \/ \E sec \in Sectors, c \in Ctrls : AcquireCoarse(sec, c)
  \/ \E rw \in Runways, sec \in Sectors, c \in Ctrls : AcquireFine(rw, sec, c)
  \/ \E u \in 1..MaxV : Submit(u)
  \/ \E u \in 1..MaxV, sec \in Sectors, rw \in Runways, c \in Ctrls : Apply(u, sec, rw, c)
  \/ \E sec \in Sectors, rw \in Runways, c \in Ctrls : ReleaseLocks(sec, rw, c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RecordReflectsAllUpdates ==
  \A u \in applied : u <= record
====
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator maintains one shared flight-plan record whose value tracks the latest update, protected by a lock hierarchy (a sector coarse lock taken before a runway fine lock). No update is ever lost, even though the network reorders messages and updates may be applied out of order. A controller takes a sector's coarse lock when it is free. A controller takes a runway's fine lock only while holding some sector's coarse lock. A controller submits a flight-plan update, which enters the update pool and may be reordered. Applying an update requires holding both a coarse and a fine lock; the record is raised to reflect that update as a monotone maximum, so applying updates in any order never loses a higher one. A controller releases the coarse and fine locks it holds.

Actions: AcquireCoarse (take a sector's coarse lock), AcquireFine (take a runway's fine lock while holding a coarse lock), Submit (submit an update into the reorderable pool), Apply (apply a pooled update while holding both locks, raising the record to reflect it), ReleaseLocks (release the coarse and fine locks held).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the shared record value is at least as large as every applied update, so no applied update is ever lost or overwritten by a smaller value.

Begin(cmd) ==
  /\ cmd \in cmdPool
  /\ reg[cmd.slot] = "loaded"
  /\ cmd.issuer \in authorized
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![cmd.slot] = "dispensing"]
  /\ server' = [server EXCEPT ![cmd.slot] = cmd.issuer]
  /\ cmdPool' = cmdPool \ {cmd}
  /\ UNCHANGED authorized

\* A dispense completes, emptying the slot.
Complete(s) ==
  /\ reg[s] = "dispensing"
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![s] = "empty"]
  /\ server' = [server EXCEPT ![s] = None]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<authorized, cmdPool>>

\* An empty slot is restocked.
Restock(s) ==
  /\ reg[s] = "empty"
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![s] = "loaded"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<server, authorized, cmdPool>>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Issuers : Authorize(i)
  \/ \E i \in Issuers : Deauthorize(i)
  \/ \E s \in Slots, i \in Issuers : SendCmd(s, i)
  \/ \E cmd \in Cmd : Begin(cmd)
  \/ \E s \in Slots : Complete(s)
  \/ \E s \in Slots : Restock(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OnlyAuthorizedDispensing ==
  \A s \in Slots : reg[s] = "dispensing" => server[s] \in authorized
====
nl:
A vending machine network dispenses products through a compare-and-swap register on each slot, and a slot may only dispense for an authorized payment issuer. Because the network reorders messages, dispense commands may be served in any order. A payment issuer becomes authorized. Authorization may be revoked, which also aborts any in-progress dispense that revoked issuer was driving, returning those slots to loaded. A dispense command is sent into the command pool. A loaded slot is compare-and-swapped to dispensing only for an authorized issuer's command, serving pooled commands in any order. A dispense completes, emptying the slot. An empty slot is restocked back to loaded.

Actions: Authorize (an issuer becomes authorized), Deauthorize (revoke authorization and abort any in-progress dispense that issuer drove), SendCmd (send a dispense command into the reorderable pool), Begin (CAS a loaded slot to dispensing only for an authorized issuer's command, in any order), Complete (finish a dispense, emptying the slot), Restock (reload an empty slot).

SAFETY PROPERTY: any slot that is currently dispensing is doing so for a currently authorized issuer, so no unauthorized or stale participant ever triggers a dispense.

---- MODULE W4Od11m3p0t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Instances, Jobs

None == "none"

VARIABLES leader, up, printing, granted
vars == <<leader, up, printing, granted>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ leader \in Instances \union {None}
  /\ up \subseteq Instances
  /\ printing \subseteq Jobs
  /\ granted \in Jobs \union {None}

Init ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ up = Instances
  /\ printing = {}
  /\ granted = None

\* A live instance with no standing leader becomes spooler coordinator.
Elect(n) ==
  /\ n \in up
  /\ leader = None
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ UNCHANGED <<up, printing, granted>>

\* The coordinating instance fails; the spooler is leaderless until failover.
Fail(n) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ up' = up \ {n}
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<printing, granted>>

\* A downed instance recovers and rejoins.
Recover(n) ==
  /\ n \notin up
  /\ up' = up \union {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, printing, granted>>

\* The leader grants the printer to a job (one grant outstanding at a time).
Grant(j) ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ granted = None
  /\ granted' = j
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up, printing>>

\* A granted job starts printing, but only while the printer is idle.
StartPrint(j) ==
  /\ granted = j
  /\ printing = {}
  /\ printing' = printing \union {j}
  /\ granted' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up>>

\* A printing job finishes and leaves the printer.
FinishPrint(j) ==
  /\ j \in printing
  /\ printing' = printing \ {j}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up, granted>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Instances : Elect(n)
  \/ \E n \in Instances : Fail(n)
  \/ \E n \in Instances : Recover(n)
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : Grant(j)
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : StartPrint(j)
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : FinishPrint(j)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualExclusion ==
  \A j1, j2 \in printing : j1 = j2
====
nl:
A print shop job spooler shares one physical printer between two independent spooler instances, coordinated by leader election with failover, so that only one job is ever on the printer at a time. A live instance with no standing leader becomes the spooler coordinator. The coordinating instance may fail, leaving the spooler leaderless until a new leader is elected; a downed instance may later recover and rejoin. The leader grants the printer to a job, with only one grant outstanding at a time. A granted job starts printing, but only while the printer is idle. A printing job finishes and leaves the printer.

Actions: Elect (a live instance with no leader becomes coordinator), Fail (the coordinator fails and the spooler becomes leaderless), Recover (a downed instance rejoins), Grant (the leader grants the printer to a job, one grant at a time), StartPrint (a granted job starts printing only while the printer is idle), FinishPrint (a printing job completes and leaves the printer).

SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one job is ever on the printer at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od12m7p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Instances, MaxLog

None == "none"
Att == [base: 0..MaxLog, inst: Instances]

VARIABLES version, ledger, pending, lastInst
vars == <<version, ledger, pending, lastInst>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ version \in 0..MaxLog
  /\ ledger \in Seq([base: 0..MaxLog])
  /\ pending \subseteq Att
  /\ lastInst \in Instances \union {None}

Init ==
  /\ version = 0
  /\ ledger = << >>
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ lastInst = None

\* An instance reads the record version to prepare a compare-and-swap write.
Read(i) ==
  /\ Cardinality(pending) < 2
  /\ version < MaxLog
  /\ pending' = pending \union {[base |-> version, inst |-> i]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, ledger, lastInst>>

\* The CAS write commits only if the version equals what the instance read,
\* appending the write on top of exactly the state it observed.
Commit(a) ==
  /\ a \in pending
  /\ a.base = version
  /\ version < MaxLog
  /\ ledger' = Append(ledger, [base |-> a.base])
  /\ version' = version + 1
  /\ lastInst' = a.inst
  /\ pending' = pending \ {a}

\* A CAS attempt whose observed version has changed fails and is retried.
Fail(a) ==
  /\ a \in pending
  /\ a.base # version
  /\ pending' = pending \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, ledger, lastInst>>

\* An instance abandons a prepared CAS attempt.
Abandon(a) ==
  /\ a \in pending
  /\ pending' = pending \ {a}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, ledger, lastInst>>

\* A donation write is withdrawn, popping the last ledger entry.
Withdraw ==
  /\ Len(ledger) > 0
  /\ ledger' = SubSeq(ledger, 1, Len(ledger) - 1)
  /\ version' = version - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, lastInst>>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Instances : Read(i)
  \/ \E a \in Att : Commit(a)
  \/ \E a \in Att : Fail(a)
  \/ \E a \in Att : Abandon(a)
  \/ Withdraw

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LenBound == Len(ledger) <= MaxLog

NoLostUpdate ==
  \A i \in DOMAIN ledger : ledger[i].base = i - 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Instances = {i1, i2}
  MaxLog = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
CONSTRAINT LenBound
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker keeps one shared donation-count record consistent under compare-and-swap, with two independent instances writing to it. No instance's write is ever silently lost. Each committed write records the record version it was built on. An instance reads the current record version to prepare a compare-and-swap write. The compare-and-swap commits only if the version still equals what the instance read, appending the write on top of exactly the state it observed, advancing the version, and noting which instance wrote. A compare-and-swap attempt whose observed version has since changed fails and would be retried, rather than clobbering the intervening write. An instance may also abandon a prepared attempt. A donation write may be withdrawn, popping the most recent ledger entry.

Actions: Read (an instance reads the version to prepare a CAS write), Commit (the CAS commits only if the version matches what was read, appending the write and advancing the version), Fail (a CAS attempt whose version changed fails and is retried), Abandon (drop a prepared attempt), Withdraw (pop the most recent write off the ledger).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the i-th committed write in the record ledger was always built on version i-1, so every write is layered on the state it observed and none is silently overwritten.

---- MODULE W4Od8m9p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Enrollments, Registrars, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES epoch, roster, acked, slow
vars == <<epoch, roster, acked, slow>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ roster \subseteq Enrollments
  /\ acked \subseteq Enrollments
  /\ slow \subseteq Registrars

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ roster = {}
  /\ acked = {}
  /\ slow = {}

\* A tentative enrollment is added to the current roster.
Enroll(e) ==
  /\ e \notin roster
  /\ roster' = roster \union {e}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, acked, slow>>

\* An enrollment already on the roster is acknowledged as durable.
Ack(e) ==
  /\ e \in roster
  /\ e \notin acked
  /\ acked' = acked \union {e}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, roster, slow>>

\* The roster is reconfigured into a new epoch, carrying forward exactly the
\* durable (acknowledged) enrollments so none of them is lost.
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ roster' = acked
  /\ UNCHANGED <<acked, slow>>

\* A tentative, not-yet-acknowledged enrollment may be dropped.
Drop(e) ==
  /\ e \in roster
  /\ e \notin acked
  /\ roster' = roster \ {e}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, acked, slow>>

\* A registrar becomes slow (lagging) but never fails.
MarkSlow(r) ==
  /\ r \notin slow
  /\ slow' = slow \union {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, roster, acked>>

\* A slow registrar resumes normal speed.
Resume(r) ==
  /\ r \in slow
  /\ slow' = slow \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, roster, acked>>

Next ==
  \/ \E e \in Enrollments : Enroll(e)
  \/ \E e \in Enrollments : Ack(e)
  \/ Reconfigure
  \/ \E e \in Enrollments : Drop(e)
  \/ \E r \in Registrars : MarkSlow(r)
  \/ \E r \in Registrars : Resume(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
  acked \subseteq roster
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Enrollments = {e1, e2}
  Registrars = {rg1, rg2}
  MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A university course-registration system maintains a roster across epoch-numbered reconfigurations, and no enrollment that has been acknowledged as durable may ever be lost across a reconfiguration. Registrars may be slow but never fail. A tentative enrollment is added to the current roster. An enrollment already on the roster is acknowledged as durable. When the roster is reconfigured into a new epoch, it carries forward exactly the acknowledged enrollments, so every durable enrollment survives the reconfiguration while merely-tentative ones may be dropped. A tentative, not-yet-acknowledged enrollment may also be dropped directly. A registrar may become slow (lagging) and later resume normal speed, but it never fails.

Actions: Enroll (add a tentative enrollment to the roster), Ack (acknowledge a rostered enrollment as durable), Reconfigure (advance the epoch, carrying forward exactly the acknowledged enrollments), Drop (remove a tentative, unacknowledged enrollment), MarkSlow (a registrar starts lagging), Resume (a slow registrar catches up).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every enrollment that has been acknowledged as durable is still on the roster, so no acknowledged enrollment is ever lost across a reconfiguration.
